card.name: Inside brand drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through newly seen brand or generic drug names split into pieces, such as COSENT-Y-X, KINERET, TECENTRIQ, tezepelumab. Strongest on the middle piece of the name in label text.

modes.label: Brand name middle
modes.description: Middle or first piece of an uppercase brand name written in capitals.
modes.example: one vial contains 5 mL of COSENT<<Y>>X solution

modes.label: Generic name pieces
modes.description: Inner piece of a lowercase generic drug name, often after hypersensitivity to.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of a drug's brand or generic name, while the name is still being spelled out.
